question: How do the powers of seeing, action, and will manifest in different subjects?
premises: The powers of seeing, action, and will have been spoken of, O Shiva.
In the gross and subtle cutting of the knowable, in order, they operate.
They become the sakala and pralayākala subjects respectively.
inference: The three powers, operating at gross and subtle levels of knowable-division, correspond to the sakala and pralayākala states.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of gross/subtle to sakala/pralayākala is compressed in the verse.
plain_english: O Shiva, the powers of seeing, action, and will, when engaged in the gross and subtle cutting of the knowable, become in order the sakala and the pralayākala.
